title: A STRONG TOWER
AGAINST THE ENEMY
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: dramatic golden sunlight breaking through dark storm clouds over mountain peaks
ancient stone watchtower on majestic rocky cliff sunlight
sunlit mountain pass golden rays heavenly sky
peaceful river flowing through quiet valley illuminated by warm sunlight
high mountain fortress ridge bathed in soft morning light
glorious light beams radiating over calm mountain lake

scenes.a: If a sudden fear about your future is pressing upon your mind right now, stay still.
Hear the eternal Word of God: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
Lord God, become this person's impenetrable fortress today. Where hidden threats linger and anxious thoughts quicken, cover them beneath your divine shield.
Father, stand firmly between them and every lurking snare, surrounding their daily path with holy strength and unshakable grace.
Lift their eyes above the storm to your ancient throne. You are their refuge, their high tower, and their constant defense against all harm.
Subscribe to walk under God's daily covering.
